_comment: Every download the match-replay setup makes, pinned. setup.ps1 refuses a file whose sha256 differs. Change a version here (with its sha256) in a PR, never on a laptop.

ffmpeg._comment: The same build AdvantageScope downloads for itself (VideoProcessor.ts); setup also puts it where AdvantageScope looks, so it never asks.

ytdlp._comment: The one pin that goes stale on its own: when YouTube changes, a clip download fails until this is bumped to a newer yt-dlp release.

deno._comment: yt-dlp needs a JavaScript runtime to read YouTube; Deno is the one it uses by default.

fieldBundle._comment: AdvantageScope's public FTC field bundle; build-assets.sh cuts the HIVE out of its 2026-2027 3D field.

assets._comment: The robot and HIVE models, as one zip on a GitHub release. Written by the Replay assets workflow; paste the tag and sha256 it prints.
